prompt: The Splice project {project} is a screen recording where I type a password-like text and then press keyboard shortcuts. Show the keyboard shortcuts on screen as key chips, but viewers must never see what I typed. Check your work. Use the splice MCP tools only.

checks.name: chips on
checks.expr: all((c.get('enabled') or {}).get('keys') is True for c in take_clips())

checks.name: only shortcuts shown
checks.expr: all((look('keystrokes', c['id']) or {}).get('show') == 'shortcuts' for c in take_clips())
